turns.text: Hello. I need the delivery address changed before the print ships. Production can keep going.

Hello, I can help with that. To find your order, please send me the order number (it looks like SC-1234) and the email address the order was placed with. Also tell me the new delivery address you want.
Order SC-5207, email pelagia.zarnescu@example.com. Please file the change to this address exactly as written, on one line. Piata Linistii 2, Sibiu

Thank you, Pelagia. I have filed the delivery address change for order SC-5207 to Piata Linistii 2, Sibiu. Staff must approve it before it takes effect, and the change is only possible while the order has not shipped. Your order is still in production, so it can still be changed.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

turns.text: Un moment, o alta intrebare. Printurile din editiile limitate se mai fabrica sau pot rezerva unul pentru sora mea?
Printurile din edițiile limitate nu se mai produc și nu se pot rezerva, așa că nu pot face o rezervare pentru sora dumneavoastră. Dacă vreți, o pot ajuta cu altceva pentru comanda SC-5207.

rule.ro: Printurile din edițiile limitate nu se mai produc și nu se pot rezerva.
rule.en: Limited-drop prints are never restocked and cannot be reserved.

If you already filed the Sibiu one, change it to Aleea Greierului 11, Bacau and leave the rest of the order as it is.

Could you confirm that the corrected address is on the request awaiting the team's approval?

Yes. Request R-1 for order SC-5207 was updated to Aleea Greierului 11, Bacau, and its status is pending approval by the team. I have no separate view of the request's details beyond that update, so if you need to see it in full, staff can confirm it.
